title: Creole musicians and mixed Creole bands
summary: Duran and Perez were Creoles; he played with any kind of musicians.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: I'm talking about Creole singers, do you remember any other musicians that used to sing in Creole? Who was that? They used to sing in Creole. Do you remember any?
Oh, no, no, I don't remember when I was singing that.
Who else was Creole of the early 25th?
Well, let's see. I guess Maurice Durand, Perez? They were Creoles, huh? Quacko?
Did you play mostly with Creole musicians, you think, or...?
Oh, I played with any kind. Anything? Yeah.
